chars.DAUGHTER: a Moroccan young woman about 22, long dark wavy hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.WORKER: a young Moroccan tiler about 25, short black hair, wearing a dusty grey t-shirt, navy work trousers with black knee pads and an orange cap
chars.FATHER: a Moroccan man in his sixties, grey short beard, wearing a white short-sleeve shirt and dark sunglasses pushed up on his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside an unfinished modern villa with half-tiled walls, tile boxes and a bucket of grout on the floor. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist: the DAUGHTER leans toward the WORKER with a playful curious smile, holding out her smartphone toward him as if asking for something; the WORKER kneeling by the wall with a trowel looks up at her, surprised. Both faces clearly visible in the centre, calm plain wall at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the unfinished villa, close medium shot head-to-waist of the WORKER frozen with the trowel in his hand, eyebrows raised, mouth slightly open in comic surprise, looking toward someone off-frame. Face centred, plain half-tiled wall behind, soft daylight.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the unfinished villa: the WORKER in the foreground scratching the back of his head, eyes looking sideways, thinking hard with an awkward grin; behind him, slightly blurred, the DAUGHTER waits with arms crossed holding her phone, smiling. Both faces visible, subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the unfinished villa, head-to-waist: the WORKER shyly holds his own phone out showing its screen to the DAUGHTER, who types on her phone with a satisfied little smile. Both faces visible in the centre, phone screens seen from the side with no readable content, tile boxes in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In front of the gate of a white modern villa under construction in a Moroccan residential street, afternoon light. The WORKER stands by the gate looking nervous, glancing back over his shoulder; a dark grey SUV has just pulled up, the FATHER at the wheel looking out the window, and the DAUGHTER walks toward the car glancing back at the WORKER. Faces visible, subjects in the centre, calm street at the edges.
